A 26-year-old man presents to his primary care physician with a 6-month history of increasing lower back pain.
He has taken acetaminophen and ibuprofen for the pain.
The pain appears to be worse in the mornings and after rest.
His temperature is 98.6°F (37.0°C), blood pressure is 115/70 mmHg, pulse is 70/min, and respirations are 12/min.
He has no significant medical history and takes no medications.
He first felt the pain while lifting boxes at work but thought that he had just strained a muscle.
